title: [Decision] A personal view's own conditions are invisible and cannot be edited: how should a reader change a saved view?
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A rep saves 「本季度开放商机」 as My view: two conditions and a sort. Opening it later, the filter panel is empty, with no badge. The sort does show. To change one condition they must add filters on top and save a new view, then delete the old one. Separately, after saving, the source 全部商机 stays filtered and reads 已个性化, so the list they came from now shows fewer rows.

Governing text: #28971 (ruling C, personal views as a user-owned object) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews.ts:159-183`. #28971's first-version exclusions do not name this case.

## Measured

- View `Eval 1104 本季度开放商机`: `config.filter` holds `stage not_in closed_won, closed_lost` and `close_date between {quarter_start}, {quarter_end}`. Five rows. The 筛选 panel reads 其中 / 添加筛选, with no conditions and no count.
- Saving a personal view from a filtered 全部商机 left the source with the filter and 已个性化.

## Options

- **A. Show and edit in the panel:** a personal view's conditions appear as ordinary rows, and editing them offers 保存 to that view. Saving a view also clears the source's temporary conditions.
- **B. Show read-only:** display the conditions and keep 另存为 as the only way to change them.
- **C. Leave it.**

## Recommendation: A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 销售每周都可能调整「我的视图」：换季度、加一个阶段。今天要重建再删除，看不到条件也容易忘了它在筛什么。另存后原列表少了行，还可能让人以为数据丢了。

**项目长远合理性。** 我的视图是用户自己的东西（#28971 裁决 C），应当能改。一份视图一份条件，也和 Studio 里编辑视图一致。

**防 AI 写错。** 存的形状不变，没有新键。规则要写清楚：条件保存在视图里，没点保存的修改只是临时的，不能悄悄写回。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 不新增能力面，只是把已上线的功能补完整。折叠不了的复杂条件仍按现有规则拒绝。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 中 | 强 | 中 |
| 不扩散 | 中 | 强 | 强 |

## Re-check

`git grep -n "foldFilterGroupToSpecRules(state.url.filters)" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews.ts`
